```{r}
library(randomForest)
library(pdp)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)

df <- read.csv("kc_house_data.csv")
features_all <- c("price", "bedrooms", "bathrooms", "sqft_living", "sqft_lot", "floors", "yr_built")
df_clean <- na.omit(df[, features_all])

set.seed(42)
df_sample <- df_clean[sample(1:nrow(df_clean), 1500), ]

cat("Training Random Forest...\n")
rf_model <- randomForest(
  price ~ bedrooms + bathrooms + sqft_living + sqft_lot + floors + yr_built,
  data = df_sample,
  ntree = 100
)

cat("Generating 1D plots...\n")

crear_grafica_1d <- function(variable) {
  pd <- partial(rf_model, pred.var = variable, train = df_sample)
  
  p <- autoplot(pd, rug = TRUE, train = df_sample) +
    geom_line(color = "blue", size = 1) +           # Línea azul
    ggtitle("Partial dependence plot") +            # Título superior
    ylab("Predicted price") +                       # Nombre eje Y
    theme_gray()                                    # Fondo gris estándar
  
  return(p)
}

p_bed   <- crear_grafica_1d("bedrooms")
p_bath  <- crear_grafica_1d("bathrooms")
p_sqft  <- crear_grafica_1d("sqft_living")
p_floor <- crear_grafica_1d("floors")

grid.arrange(p_bed, p_bath, p_sqft, p_floor, ncol = 2)

cat("Generating 2D heatmaps...\n")

pd_2d_1 <- partial(rf_model, pred.var = c("sqft_living", "bathrooms"), train = df_sample)
mapa_1 <- plotPartial(pd_2d_1, levelplot = TRUE, zlab = "Precio", main = "Heatmap: Sqft vs Bathrooms")

pd_2d_2 <- partial(rf_model, pred.var = c("sqft_living", "bedrooms"), train = df_sample)
mapa_2 <- plotPartial(pd_2d_2, levelplot = TRUE, zlab = "Precio", main = "Heatmap: Sqft vs Bedrooms")

print(mapa_1)
print(mapa_2)
```
